title: Additive-arrow conjugacy of the restricted and original stalk comparisons
statement: Let f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S and g':X'→X form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], with derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category]. Let K,K' and φ:L(g')*K→K' be given and c be K-flat coordinates for φ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let V⊆S and V'⊆S' satisfy V'⊆g⁻¹V, put U=f⁻¹V and U'=f'⁻¹V', and let j:U'→U satisfy j≫U.ι=U'.ι≫g'. Suppose the restricted square j,f'|V',f|V,g.resLE(V,V') is cartesian. Define K₀,K₀',φ₀ by exact open restriction and the canonical restricted coefficient [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For any K-flat coordinate presentation d of φ₀, every z∈U' and every integer i, the additive arrows underlying stalkComparison for d at z in the restricted square and for c at z.val in the original square are isomorphic in Arrow(AddCommGrpCat). No isomorphism assumption on either comparison is imposed. The comparisons use the actual stalk maps and localized tensor cohomology model [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model].

proof.text: At z use the four actual open-immersion stalk maps and point equalities from hj and restriction squares to identify R,A,B,C. StalkMap_comp identifies their structure maps; the two restriction equations for tensorMap identify A tensor-over-R B and its map to C by the tensor-product universal property.

Exact derived stalks of c.e and d.e identify the two source representatives under the open stalk ring equivalences. Apply the restriction-stalk extension comparison and the canonical overFunctor/restrictFunctor isomorphism. Transport left-derived scalar extension through these exact equivalences; uniqueness of the counit-compatible derived functor supplies a B-linear cohomology isomorphism. The cohomologyIso_smul equations and tensor induction lift it to the tensor algebra; extend to C and forget scalars. Exact derived stalks of c.e' and d.e' similarly give the target additive isomorphism.

Normalize the maps by their target identifications. Naturality of homology and represents replace each chain map by its derived coefficient after cancelling the invertible pullback counit. The stalk criterion supplies K-flat stalks, so ordinary A-to-C scalar extension computes derived pullback. Model comparison_eq and localized_eq express the maps by the derived counits and their adjunction transposes; their naturality under the identified ring and representative isomorphisms gives a commuting square. The pinned composition comparisons and the leftDerivedUnique factorization identity for singleComplexOpenPullbackIso identify the restricted coefficient with exactly the coefficient used in d. This is the cross-ring version of the normalized comparison calculation.

Package the two additive isomorphisms and their commuting square with Arrow.isoMk. Empty opens give no point z; the argument also applies to top opens and zero rings and complexes. No boundedness, quasi-coherence or flatness over R is used.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_singleComplexOpen_stalk_arrow_iso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' K K' φ)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV'))
    (d : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates j
      ((schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
      ((schemeOpenRestriction X' (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V')).mapDerivedCategory.obj K')
      (singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient g' K K' φ
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj)) :
    ∀ (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) (i : ℤ),
      Nonempty
        (Arrow.mk ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme.presheaf.stalk z))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
              (SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison
                (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ d z i)) ≅
          Arrow.mk ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z.val))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
              (SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison f f' g g' sq c z.val i)))
